invariants.rationale: The method returns a new BulkInsertPartitioner instance for supported sort modes, so result cannot be null for these cases.
Only NONE and GLOBAL_SORT are handled; other values cause an exception to be thrown.
If sortMode is NONE, the returned result is a JavaNonSortPartitioner.
If sortMode is GLOBAL_SORT, the returned result is a JavaGlobalSortPartitioner.
